candidates.change_summary: Removed the require(amount > 0) check, allowing transfers of zero or negative amounts (though negative uint is impossible, zero transfers succeed).
Changed payable(receiver).transfer(amount) to payable(receiver).transfer(0), so the amount argument is ignored and zero wei is always sent.
Changed require(amount > 0) to require(amount >= 0), which allows amount = 0 to pass and trigger a zero transfer.
